text:
I haven't run anything yet. Three things need your answer first.

**1. acme/webapp will stop running CI.** Its workflows use `runs-on: [self-hosted, tentmaker, ...]`, and no other device serves that repo. Once Tentmaker is gone, those jobs wait forever for a runner. Do you want me to point them back at GitHub-hosted runners first? That means a commit in the acme/webapp checkout. Tell me the checkout path, and whether you want a commit on a branch or a direct revert of the migrate commit. Or, if you'd rather leave them as they are, say so and I'll skip this.

**2. Purge.** Complete removal means `uninstall --purge`, which deletes the config, the stored forge token, state, cache and logs on this Mac. The token only leaves this machine. If it was a dedicated token, you should also revoke it on GitHub. Confirm that I should purge.

**3. Tart VMs.** If Tentmaker installed Tart for sandboxes, I'd leave Tart in place unless you say otherwise, since other tools may use it.

Once you've answered, I'll run this:

```sh
# Current state, for the record
tentmaker status --json
tentmaker repo list --json
tentmaker pool --json

# Only after step 1 is settled and you confirm the purge
sudo -n true && echo "root ok"
sudo tentmaker uninstall --purge --yes --json

# Remove the binary (it may also exist in ~/.local/bin)
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/tentmaker
rm -f ~/.local/bin/tentmaker

# Verify nothing is left
command -v tentmaker || echo "binary gone"
sudo launchctl print system/dev.tentmaker.daemon 2>&1 | head -1   # expect "Could not find service"
ls -la /Library/LaunchDaemons/dev.tentmaker.daemon.plist "/Library/Application Support/Tentmaker" /Library/Logs/Tentmaker 2>&1
tart list 2>/dev/null                                             # VMs Tentmaker created should be gone
dscl . -read /Users/tentmaker-runner 2>&1 | head -1               # expect "eDSRecordNotFound" if any runner user remains
```

If any verification step still finds something, I'll report it and ask before deleting anything else by hand.
